LeadHub

Lead Generation • CRM • Follow-up • Conversion

Multi-tenant loan agent website and lead dashboard SaaS

This project gives each loan agent a public fintech-style website, a secure private dashboard, tenant-isolated lead management, public lead capture, EMI tools, WhatsApp actions, and profile controls powered by Supabase Auth, Postgres, and Row Level Security.

Agent websites

Public pages update from each agent profile and support mobile-first lead capture.

Lead CRM

Agents manage statuses, notes, WhatsApp follow-up, and deletions from one dashboard.

Secure tenancy

Supabase RLS keeps every profile, lead, and note isolated by logged-in user.

Production ready

Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Vercel-ready setup, and Brevo SMTP guidance.

Prepared on 8 June 2026
